subject: Country-specific data escrow & peering: APAC hosting and VPC availability statement
body:
From: Amy Chen <amy.chen@datasafe.io>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-06T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Country-specific data escrow & peering: APAC hosting and VPC availability statement

Hi Olga,

Thanks for taking this early look. GreenBank is progressing through our procurement legal and security review and we hit a couple of items that we need explicit confirmation on before we can move to contract signature:

- Hosting region: we require confirmed single-country residency for customer data (Singapore) for the GreenBank environment. Can Redwood commit to keeping request/response payloads, logs, and persistent model artifacts for this tenant strictly within Singapore unless explicit export is requested?
- VPC/private deployment: we will use a Private deployment (VPC) with direct peering. Please confirm availability of a private peering option in APAC (Singapore) and whether private peering endpoints are generally provisioned to support cross-account peering or if you use transit VPCs.
- Data escrow: as a financial institution we need an in-country data escrow option or export runbook for emergency recoverability. Do you offer an escrow partner or will Redwood provide an encrypted export and key-handover process for in-country escrow?
- Evidence: GreenBank validator needs an attestation letter on Redwood letterhead that covers region commitment and VPC peering availability (we will accept DocuSign). A short technical appendix mentioning KMS partitioning and SOC 2 scope would be ideal.

I attached our SIG summary (GreenBank-SIG.pdf) for context. Can we get a response by EOD Friday?

Best,
Amy
Senior Security Program Manager
DataSafe (procurement for GreenBank)

---
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Amy Chen <amy.chen@datasafe.io>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-06T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Country-specific data escrow & peering: APAC hosting and VPC availability statement

Hi Amy —

Thanks for the clear ask and for sending the SIG. Short answer: yes, we can meet the requirements in the ways described below. Im looping in Karthik (security/infra) and Marissa (platform ops) to provide the technical appendix and export runbook. Attached: initial APAC peering matrix + VPC topology sketch.

High level commitments we can provide now:
- Region residency: Redwood will host GreenBank tenant data (requests, generated outputs, embeddings, and application logs) in our Singapore region (GCP asia-southeast1 / AWS ap-southeast-1) for the tenant you designate. Persistent model caches and customer artifacts will be stored in-region unless you request an export.
- Private peering: We offer customer-dedicated VPC peering in Singapore with options for cross-account VPC peering (direct) or a managed transit approach. Lead time for a dedicated peering setup is typically 2-3 weeks after network approvals.
- Data escrow & export: We do not operate an internal escrow vault, but we will: (a) produce an encrypted, verifiable export package scoped to the tenant (with manifest and checksums); (b) provide a KMS-wrapped key handover or coordinate with your escrow partner; and (c) include an export runbook for in-country transfer.

Next steps: Karthik, can you draft the technical appendix (KMS partitioning, control plane egress behavior, SOC 2 boundary notes, and CAIQ pointers)? Marissa, can you sanity-check the peering lead time and fill in network contact details? Amy/James: we'll prepare a one-page attestation and route it through DocuSign.

Thanks,

Olga Petrov
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0119

Attachments referenced: apac-peering-matrix.xlsx, vpc-topology-diagram.pdf

---
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Amy Chen <amy.chen@datasafe.io>
Cc: olga.petrov@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-07T09:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Country-specific data escrow & peering: APAC hosting and VPC availability statement

Hi Amy —

Putting the technical appendix here (summary, will provide a PDF appendix on the Drive link):

1) Hosting and KMS segmentation
- Tenant isolation: GreenBank will be deployed into a tenant-specific VPC and storage accounts scoped to the Singapore region.
- KMS: Customer data keys are partitioned per-tenant. You can bring-your-own-key (BYOK) via AWS KMS import or GCP CMEK. Control-plane metadata (scheduling, routing) is routed through our control plane; we limit payloads to non-sensitive metadata and metrics. Customer request/response payloads and embeddings are persistently stored only in the Singapore region buckets.

2) Control plane and control metadata
- Control plane: For Private deployments we offer a customer-managed control plane option (VPC peering + private endpoints) so API tokens and sensitive routing info do not traverse the public internet.
- Egress: Short-lived operational telemetry (service health metrics, anonymized error rates) may be reported to our monitoring cluster in us-central1; logs and customer data remain in-region unless export is performed by the customer or by a documented emergency process.

3) Private peering options and topology
- Direct VPC peering: supported (cross-account peering to customer VPC).
- Transit model: we can provide a managed transit VPC where required for complex network topologies. Diagram attached (vpc-topology-diagram.pdf).
- IP ranges: we'll provide a precise CIDR allocation sheet during network onboarding. Typical lead time: 10 business days after exchange of firewall rules and touchpoints.

4) Data escrow / export runbook
- Export artifacts: tenant data export will include data + manifest + SHA256 checksums. Exports can be encrypted with customer-supplied KMS keys.
- Escrow partner: we have preferred partners in APAC (list available on request). If you require in-country escrow, we will coordinate the export and key transfer to your chosen escrow provider.

5) Controls & certification notes
- SOC 2: Redwoods SOC 2 (Type II) report covers production-hosted inference workloads; we'll include a cover note specifying GreenBanks tenant scope where applicable.
- SIG/CAIQ: we will provide a completed CAIQ slice for the customer tenant and point to relevant SIG artifacts.

If this is acceptable I will prepare a short technical appendix (PDF) that can be appended to the attestation letter.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

---
From: James O'Rourke <jorourke@greenbank.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com, amy.chen@datasafe.io
Date: 2026-10-08T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Country-specific data escrow & peering: APAC hosting and VPC availability statement

Olga/Amy,

Thanks, this is useful. Two requests before we accept the attestation:
1) Can Redwood commit to the statement that there will be no cross-border replication of customer data outside Singapore for routine operations? (we understand backups and export runbooks are exceptions but want that explicit)
2) We need an attestation clause that the peering option will be available as part of the Private deployment within X days (please propose X).

Also confirm that Redwood will accept DocuSign for the attestation and that the attached technical appendix can be referenced by name in the DocuSign document.

Regards,
James O'Rourke
Director, Risk & Compliance
GreenBank

---
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: James O'Rourke <jorourke@greenbank.com>, Amy Chen <amy.chen@datasafe.io>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-09T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Country-specific data escrow & peering: APAC hosting and VPC availability statement

James —

We can provide the attestation with the explicit language you requested. Proposed clauses (for the letter):
- Residency clause: "Redwood Inference attests that, for the GreenBank tenant designated for Singapore, customer data (including request/response payloads, embeddings, and persistent logs) will not be replicated outside the Singapore region for routine operations. Export or cross-border replication will only occur as initiated by the customer or under an agreed emergency export process documented below."
- Peering availability clause: "Redwood Inference will provision a Private peering connection in Singapore for the GreenBank tenant with an estimated provisioning SLA of 15 business days from completion of network handshakes and firewall rule exchange."

We accept DocuSign for signature and will attach the technical appendix by reference ("Appendix A: Redwood technical appendix for GreenBank - APAC"). Ill prepare the attestation on letterhead, upload to DocuSign, and send a link. Attached: data-escrow-terms.docx (draft language for the escrow process).

Action items:
- Amy/James: confirm acceptance of the 15 business day peering SLA and DocuSign as signature method.
- GreenBank: provide contact for escrow provider (if you have a named partner).
- Redwood (Karthik/Marissa): finalize Appendix A PDF and confirm the CIDR exchange timeline.

I'll send the DocuSign link once we have confirmation on the peering SLA.

Best,

Olga Petrov
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0119

Attachments referenced: data-escrow-terms.docx
